Prompt 12 builds the complete intelligence surface for the dashboard — transforming it from a task manager into a strategic command center. This includes: the Strategic Outlook Panel (7-day forward intelligence brief), Behavioral Insight Card (one actionable behavioral insight per condition change), Blueprint Health Panel (real-time blueprint status with governance alerts), Signal Trend Analysis (deeper signal intelligence beyond the 4 bars), the Predictive Execution Brief (what Bhudhi sees coming based on current patterns), and the full Governance Queue Action Center. When Prompt 12 is complete, every piece of intelligence Bhudhi has generated is accessible, usable, and displayed in operational execution language.

Dashboard panels display intelligence — they never trigger system actions. Clicking 'Accept Proposal' on the Governance Queue Panel calls the approval API which routes through GovernanceService — the dashboard is never a shortcut around governance.
The 7-Day Outlook is generated by Bhudhi using signal trend data. It is clearly marked as a projection, not a certainty. Confidence tier is always shown on predictive outputs.

Behavioral insights are surfaced as observations, not directives. Bhudhi notes patterns — the user decides what to do with them. No behavioral insight can override task generation rules or conditions.

PART 7 — EXECUTION LANGUAGE FOR NEW PANELS
PANEL LANGUAGE RULES — ENFORCE THESE IN EVERY COMPONENT
'Execution Trajectory' not 'Forecast'. 'Momentum signals indicate' not 'You will'. 'Execution window open' not 'Good time'. 'Pattern confidence: Medium' not 'This might happen'.
'Execution pattern detected' not 'I noticed'. 'Signal evidence shows' not 'Your data suggests'. 'Execution opportunity' not 'Good news'.
'Momentum trajectory' not 'Progress'. 'Signal movement' not 'Your scores'. 'Execution signal: Rising' not 'You are improving'.
'Blueprint health: Strong' not 'Your plan is good'. 'Execution continuity: Active' not 'You are on track'. 'Phase advancement ready' not 'Next step unlocked'.
'Blueprint restructure proposed' not 'AI suggests'. 'Execute proposal' not 'Apply change'. 'Evidence-based recommendation' not 'I think you should'.
